resources.string: VoiceDJ
Before you start
VoiceDJ can listen continuously for a wake word so you can control Spotify without touching your phone. That means the microphone stays open. Here is exactly what happens, so you can decide.
The microphone stays open while listening is on
Audio is processed on this device by a wake-word engine that only ever looks for your chosen wake word. Nothing is recorded to a file, and nothing leaves the phone during this stage.
Only after the wake word is heard does anything get sent

Your next few seconds of speech are passed to the speech recogniser on your phone to be turned into text. Depending on your device settings, Android may process this on-device or send it to Google, exactly as it does for any other voice input. VoiceDJ never stores or transmits the audio itself.
You can see it and stop it at any time

While listening is on there is a permanent notification you cannot swipe away, with a Stop button. Listening never starts on its own — not at boot, not in the background. It starts only when someone taps Start in the app.
Other people around you have not agreed to this
An open microphone may pick up other people in the room. Consider telling them, and avoid leaving listening on in private conversations or meetings.
I understand the microphone stays open while listening is on
I am responsible for how this is used around other people
Accept and continue
No thanks — tap-to-talk only
You can withdraw this at any time in Settings, which stops listening immediately. This choice is stored on this device only.

VoiceDJ needs microphone access to hear the wake word. Without it, only the on-screen controls work.
